annotation.organism: Buchnera aphidicola subsp. Baizongia pistaciae (strain Bp)
function: Part of a sulfur-relay system required for 2-thiolation of 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine (mnm(5)s(2)U) at tRNA wobble positions.
